question_text:
The unit cell for $\mathrm{Al}_{2} \mathrm{O}_{3}$ has hexagonal symmetry with lattice parameters $a=0.4759 \mathrm{~nm}$ and $c=1.2989 \mathrm{~nm}$. If the density of this material is $3.99 \mathrm{~g} / \mathrm{cm}^{3}$, calculate its atomic packing factor. For this computation use ionic radii listed in  table 3.4 .

Refer to  table 3.4 :
 table 3.4 
lonic Radii for Several Cations and Anions for a Coordination Number of 6
\begin{tabular}{|l|l|l|l|}
\hline Cation & Ionic Radius (nm) & Anion & Ionic Radius (nm) \\
\hline $\mathrm{Al}^{3+}$ & 0.053 & $\mathrm{Br}^{-}$ & 0.196 \\
\hline $\mathrm{Ba}^{2+}$ & 0.136 & $\mathrm{Cl}^{-}$ & 0.181 \\
\hline $\mathrm{Ca}^{2+}$ & 0.100 & $\mathrm{F}^{-}$ & 0.133 \\
\hline $\mathrm{Cs}^{+}$ & 0.170 & $\mathrm{I}^{-}$ & 0.220 \\
\hline $\mathrm{Fe}^{2+}$ & 0.077 & $\mathrm{O}^{2-}$ & 0.140 \\
\hline $\mathrm{Fe}^{3+}$ & 0.069 & $\mathrm{S}^{2-}$ & 0.184 \\
\hline $\mathrm{K}^{+}$ & 0.138 & & \\
\hline $\mathrm{Mg}^{2+}$ & 0.072 & & \\
\hline $\mathrm{Mn}^{2+}$ & 0.067 & & \\
\hline $\mathrm{Na}^{+}$ & 0.102 & & \\
\hline $\mathrm{Ni}^{2+}$ & 0.069 & & \\
\hline $\mathrm{Si}^{4+}$ & 0.040 & & \\
\hline $\mathrm{Ti}^{4+}$ & 0.061 & & \\
\hline
\end{tabular}
response:
## Step-by-step solution

**1. Volume of the hexagonal unit cell**

$$V_c = a^2 c \sin(120^\circ) = a^2 c \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$$

With $a = 0.4759\,\text{nm}$, $c = 1.2989\,\text{nm}$:

$$V_c = (0.4759)^2(1.2989)\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} = 0.2548\,\text{nm}^3 = 2.548\times10^{-22}\,\text{cm}^3$$

**2. Number of formula units per unit cell (from density)**

$$\rho = \frac{nM}{V_c N_A}\;\Rightarrow\; n = \frac{\rho V_c N_A}{M}$$

$M_{\text{Al}_2\text{O}_3}=2(26.98)+3(16.00)=101.96\,\text{g/mol}$, so

$$n = \frac{(3.99)(2.548\times10^{-22})(6.022\times10^{23})}{101.96} \approx 6$$

So the unit cell contains **6 formula units** → $12\,\text{Al}^{3+}$ ions and $18\,\text{O}^{2-}$ ions.

**3. Atomic packing factor**

Using $r_{\text{Al}^{3+}}=0.053\,\text{nm}$ and $r_{\text{O}^{2-}}=0.140\,\text{nm}$:

$$\text{APF} = \frac{12\left(\tfrac{4}{3}\pi r_{\text{Al}}^3\right)+18\left(\tfrac{4}{3}\pi r_{\text{O}}^3\right)}{V_c}$$

$$= \frac{12\left(\tfrac{4}{3}\pi(0.053)^3\right)+18\left(\tfrac{4}{3}\pi(0.140)^3\right)}{0.2548} \approx 0.842$$

$$\boxed{0.842}$$
